newsitem.title: USA: Group lifts stake in Industrial Holdings.
newsitem.headline: Group lifts stake in Industrial Holdings.

text.p: A group of Houston investment managers that includes St. James Capital Corp said on Tuesday that it raised its stake in Industrial Holdings Inc to the equivalent of 835,000 common shares, or 16.5 percent of the total from the equivalent of 295,000 shares, or 5.8 percent.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said that on November 18, it acquired warrants to buy 540,000 shares of common stock at $7 a share.
